#Q1
```{r}
data = read.csv(file = "https://ckan0.cf.opendata.inter.prod-toronto.ca/dataset/21c83b32-d5a8-4106-a54f-010dbe49f6f2/resource/55d58477-50f5-490c-8da8-5953e3b26ca4/download/daily-shelter-overnight-service-occupancy-capacity-2022.csv")

pop = na.omit(data$CAPACITY_ACTUAL_ROOM)

#data %>% select(CAPACITY_ACTUAL_ROOM) -> p
#p = na.omit(p)
pop_avg = mean(pop)
pop_avg

x = sample(pop, size =500)
qnorm(c(0.1, 0.9), mean=mean(x), sd=sd(x)/sqrt(500))
t.test(x, conf.level = 0.8)
```

#Q2
```{r}
bootstrap = function(){
  s = sample(x, size = 500, replace = T)
  return (mean(s))
}
bootstrap_x_bar = replicate(100000, bootstrap())
quantile(bootstrap_x_bar, c(0.1, 0.9))
```
